ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the M2-2,
Light Industry District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 14-H in the area
bound by:

aline 148.32 feet south of and parallel to West 58th Street; South Hoyne Avenue; a line
222.84 feet south of and parallel to West 58th Street; and the alley next west of and
parallel to South Hoyne Avenue,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
